status: Unaccepted artistic benchmark; technical completion only
method: Native-resolution visual inspection of six actual decoded H.264 export frames, plus native append RGBA still. Entire MP4 and all96 PNGs fully decoded by FFmpeg/Pillow. No real-time playback was performed by this audit.
observations: The hard horizontal ignition crop edge seen in the first GPU test is removed by a native UV alpha falloff.
The growing soot plume retains detailed irregular lobes and torn fine edges in the H.264 export.
The contact point stays behind the native held foreground grass/path masking.
The late low dust widens at the ground rather than following the plume crown.
The camera, children and scenery remain held by design; their stillness is not an animation result.
Late plume samples retain substantially the same main lobe silhouette and painted core illumination. This is an unresolved art weakness.
limits: No claim that sampled frames establish convincing full-speed temporal motion.
2.5D deformation and UV advection do not create new volumetric billows or evolving self-shadow.
H.264 preview is1080p; the separate still is native4K. Individual hero texture is1254x1254 and dust2172x724.
Single held shot does not establish integration with a moving production camera, emitter or character animation.
review_decision: Deliver the concrete motion proof for artistic review. Do not declare cinematic acceptance or finish a larger pack using this method until its motion quality is accepted or revised.
